name: Bubble Gaze Lens
summary: A gaze-based selection technique that combines the bubble cursor idea with a lens mechanism to support more accurate target selection through eye gaze.
howItWorks: The user looks toward a target region. The system activates a lens around the gaze position, helping reveal, enlarge, or clarify nearby candidate targets so the intended one can be selected more accurately.
advantages: Selecting small or dense targets with gaze when users need additional visual support to distinguish the intended target from nearby alternatives.
limitations: The lens can add visual complexity and may be less suitable when the interface should remain visually minimal or when targets move quickly.
